purpose: Determine whether public.luna_research_formula_returns_v2 formula_id=0 is the same monthly return series as the locked production M1 strategy. This is an identity check, not a relative-performance ranking.

source.date_alignment: date_trunc('month', month_end)::date; inner join on month key

series_fingerprint.algorithm: PostgreSQL md5 over string_agg(month_key || ':' || net_return::text, '|' ordered by month_key)
series_fingerprint.caveat: Fingerprints verify the exact ordered text representation returned by PostgreSQL for this query; they are not SHA-256 source-file hashes.

interpretation: The alias is not an apples-to-apples benchmark for the locked production M1 monthly series.
High correlation alone is insufficient to establish identity.
Do not rank or promote formulas using the alias as if it were the exact M1 benchmark.

related_holdings_check.formation_rule: Cross-sectional mom1 ascending, top 20 symbols by month_end in public.luna_research_monthly_price_factors
related_holdings_check.reference: Top 20 rank_no holdings for luna-m1s0k20rev-v1 in public.luna_strategy_monthly_holdings
related_holdings_check.interpretation: The candidate proxy reproduces some, but not all, production selections. This is not the same holdings series.

dataset_coverage.warning: Panel coverage alone does not prove point-in-time listing/universe membership.

formula_recovery.instruction: Do not reconstruct or infer the missing formula definition from its similar label.
